info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Investment Portfolio Withdraw-v5-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management of investment portfolio withdrawals within a financial application. It allows users to effectively remove specific withdrawal transactions associated with their investment portfolios. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, portfolio managers, and investment advisors who require streamlined control over withdrawal processes. By enabling precise deletion of withdrawal records, it enhances operational efficiency and data accuracy for investment management systems.

delete.summary: Remove a withdrawal from the portfolio.
delete.description: This endpoint allows users to delete a specific withdrawal entry from their portfolio. Ensure that the withdrawal ID is correctly specified to avoid unintended deletions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details for withdrawing funds from a portfolio. It should contain the necessary information to process the withdrawal request.

200.description: The withdrawal request was completed successfully and processed.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for withdrawing a portfolio operation through a DELETE request.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRespons.title: Delete Portfolio Withdrawal Response

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the withdrawal operation.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the withdrawal deletion.

state.description: Current state of the withdrawal after the deletion operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the deletion request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Message providing additional information regarding the deletion operation.

DeleteInvestmentPortfolioWithdrawRespons.description: Response schema for the successful deletion of a portfolio withdrawal.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: User who created the withdrawal entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the withdrawal entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the withdrawal entry was created automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Schema to provide details about the audit of the deletion operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.

schema.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
